reply.summary: Rilira is a forensic analyst with a quiet ambition and a borrowed frost projector, using it to clear anyone standing between a desk and a promotion. Every victim becomes a puzzle for colleagues she controls, until a mask slips at the wrong moment.

feats.scene: Rilira freezes a supervisor solid with a single burst from the projector.
Rilira takes a hard shove into a lab bench and keeps moving.

reply.summary: Valrnuval began as a gentle researcher dreaming of a protective generation of improved people, then tested the process on himself. The change warped his kindness into a need to rule, and his mind now broadcasts orders to every listener on the planet.

feats.scene: Valrnuval raises a volcanic island from the open sea and sends a giant wave across the ocean as a mere side effect.
Valrnuval shrugs off the collapse of a research tower around his swollen body.

reply.summary: Toreorn is a loyal field operative in a rewritten world, guarding a prisoner she slowly realises was never the villain. Once her false memories crack she turns on her own commander and leads a daring escape.

feats.scene: Toreorn lands a trained strike on a guard in a narrow corridor.
Toreorn is thrown across a laboratory floor and gets back up swinging.

reply.summary: Linumtu is a freelance photographer whose warmth steadies a young hero through his first uncertain months. Her bright, ordinary life ends too soon, and what she left behind shapes him for years.

feats.scene: Linumtu swings her camera bag at an intruder in a dark stairwell.
Linumtu is knocked flat on a concrete floor by a much larger attacker.

reply.summary: Resranum takes over a harbor crime family after her father dies and fights a bloody turf war across the docks. She breaks alliances as easily as she makes them, double-crossing a rival at a staged meeting.

feats.scene: Resranum orders an ambush that wipes out a rival crew in a warehouse.
Resranum survives a car crash on a wet bridge with only bruises.

reply.summary: Nticortes is a brilliant chemist who lost her husband and puts all the blame on a famous flying hero. She plots patiently in a private lab, building traps meant for someone who cannot be hurt.

feats.scene: Nticortes detonates a lab-built charge that collapses a loading dock.
Nticortes stumbles through a smoke-filled stairwell after her own device backfires.

reply.summary: Nelniulia is a skyborne raider who despises smokestacks and wants a new century stopped before it starts. From a patched balloon-ship he focuses sunlight through a giant lens and burns a slum to the ground.

feats.scene: Nelniulia sweeps a focused sunbeam over a crowded slum and sets entire streets alight.
Nelniulia crashes through a hull of brittle timber and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Aniari was altered in a secret lab until his voice became a weapon, a boom that rolls from his chest and cannot be switched off. Implants keep the echoes in check, barely.

feats.scene: Aniari unleashes a booming shout that cracks the walls of a concrete bunker.
Aniari endures the roar of his own echo bouncing around a steel cell.

reply.summary: Sortia is a gloomy ex-astronaut with a mind that leaks whatever he feels into the heads around him. He earns his keep questioning suspects at a busy precinct and shares his flat with a clever primate.

feats.scene: Sortia pushes a suspect's thoughts into the open during a long interrogation.
Sortia powers through a brutal morning after a long night of drinking.

reply.summary: Talvi is a hardened ex-soldier haunted by an old crime at sea, now guarding a deep-diving research craft. When something ancient wakes in a wreck, he sacrifices himself by overloading the ship's experimental core.

feats.scene: Talvi triggers a collapsing singularity engine that tears apart a cosmic horror.
Talvi hauls himself through a flooding corridor under crushing pressure.

reply.summary: Rustoncin is a red-haired schemer with a hundred false names who spends decades trying to ruin the strongest man alive. He prefers cruelty by rocket, striking at friends instead of the target himself.

feats.scene: Rustoncin launches a salvo of homemade missiles at a newspaper building.
Rustoncin walks out of a collapsing hideout covered in dust.

reply.summary: Tecor is a retired spacefarer pulled into a squad of armoured guardians after a rescue from the sky. Strapped into a bulky red exosuit, he leads an elite unit through border emergencies.

feats.scene: Tecor blasts a stalled tank into scrap from the shoulder cannons of his suit.
Tecor stands inside the armour as a missile detonates against the chest plate.

reply.summary: Tanel is a refugee inventor who built a helmet that hardens whatever its wearer imagines into real matter. Hunted by a greedy tycoon, he puts it on once in anger and then learns to put it down for good.

feats.scene: Tanel imagines a wall of rock and watches it slam down on a pack of thugs.
Tanel is dragged across a circus yard by guards and keeps his grip on the helmet.

reply.summary: Lencor works under a grease-stained apron by day and runs errands for a crime ring by night. He is bald, quiet and careful, and the crew trusts him with engines, not with decisions.

feats.scene: Lencor swings a wrench into a rival's knee behind a garage.
Lencor takes a beating in a back room and refuses to talk.

reply.summary: Ninrn is a dreamer raised on tales of fantastic machines, turned away by his ruler and driven abroad. He builds an enormous underwater vessel, crews it with outcasts and plunders sunken fortunes.

feats.scene: Ninrn rams his hulking vessel into a merchant ship and splits it in two.
Ninrn rides out a deep-sea storm inside the riveted hull.

reply.summary: Ratia lost her village to chainsaws and carries a bond with wild creatures that lets her borrow their gifts after a single glance. She is a future rebel who fights for animals, living and extinct.

feats.scene: Ratia takes the strength of a charging beast and flips a delivery truck.
Ratia borrows the thick hide of a rhino and shrugs off a barrage.

reply.summary: Tilva is a former chemistry student dazzled by a clown prince of crime, now a gleeful accomplice with a taste for poisons. She mixes noxious cocktails and throws them with startling accuracy.

feats.scene: Tilva hurls a vial of caustic gas that empties a crowded theatre.
Tilva tumbles down a flight of stairs laughing and gets up unhurt.

reply.summary: Cellis was a firebrand extremist before the night-feeders overran the city, and now rules a thriving underground bazaar with red eyes and a cold smile. Her fangs are for negotiating.

feats.scene: Cellis flings a rival across the bazaar and through a market stall.
Cellis walks away from a wall of gunfire, her wounds already closing.

reply.summary: Terte is the lonely heir of a famous villain, a clever and slighted girl who spurns her father's path until a snub breaks her. She rewires the guardian machines of a peaceful age and turns them on whole cities.

feats.scene: Terte commands rebuilt guardian machines to level an entire city.
Terte is thrown against a console in a tense stand-off.

reply.summary: Ranco is a bald inventor in a mirror-image world where the lawmen are the outlaws. He chases the wrong pair of strangers across rooftops, then redeems everyone with a brain-altering device.

feats.scene: Ranco fires a rewiring device that flips a whole gang's loyalties.
Ranco survives a lab explosion behind a heavy desk.

reply.summary: Taunti is a bald genius who keeps changing his name, his crime and his gadgets while nursing a lifelong grudge. Strapped into a bulky battle rig, he is a spiteful, endlessly inventive threat to a hero who cannot be killed.

feats.scene: Taunti levels a stadium with the armoured fists and cannon of his battle suit.
Taunti takes a point-blank blast inside the suit and walks out.

reply.summary: Lorsa steers a polished convertible through crowded streets, a cheerful servant who keeps a double secret behind a polite smile. Nobody guesses that the driver knows exactly who is under the cowl.

feats.scene: Lorsa hauls a heavy crate into the boot of the car single-handed.
Lorsa tumbles out of the driver seat during a sharp turn and dusts himself off.

reply.summary: Milnt is a dignified manservant in a bright, silly world who hides a talent for disguise, fencing and archery. He turns up in unlikely costumes whenever his household needs a quiet rescue.

feats.scene: Milnt fells a bumbling crook with a well-aimed fencing thrust.
Milnt is dunked in a trap-filled pond and emerges unruffled.

reply.summary: Varll keeps a grand house running, carrying out tea trays, bandages and dry remarks with equal calm. Every wound that comes home gets stitched by hands that never shake.

feats.scene: Varll cracks a fire poker across the wrist of an intruder in a hallway.
Varll holds the door against a pounding crowd until help arrives.

reply.summary: Torason is a white-haired caretaker minding a clocktower full of young heroines, fussing over birthrights and meals. He keeps a shotgun and a revolver close, and uses both without drama.

feats.scene: Torason fires a shotgun through a locked door to scatter a gang of burglars.
Torason is shoved into a bookcase and rises with his tea tray intact.

reply.summary: Ancoli is a watchful valet in a moody animated city, the one person who sees the grieving boy under the vigilante's cowl. He offers cold soup and quiet loyalty to a young master too hurt to thank him.

feats.scene: Ancoli shoves open a stuck cellar door to reach an injured ward.
Ancoli stays at his post through a night of coughing smoke.

reply.summary: Naeosar serves a ruthless tyrant under a hidden threat, with an explosive device lodged beside his spine to guarantee obedience. He finally walks out and hands the proof to the police.

feats.scene: Naeosar slams a ledger onto a desk and demands that the officers read it.
Naeosar lives for years beside a charge that could end him at a whim.

reply.summary: Autor is a fussy former records clerk turned live-in guardian of an orphaned heir. Under a madman's laughing gas he wrecks an elegant sitting room, then spends the next morning mortified and sweeping.

feats.scene: Autor smashes furniture and shatters windows while lost in a giggling haze.
Autor staggers through a thick cloud of gas and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Rnicisle is a steady house servant whose calm voice leads a team through a cavern full of screens and trophies. His work is tidy, quiet and nearly invisible, which is how he likes it.

feats.scene: Rnicisle drags a heavy equipment crate across the cavern floor.
Rnicisle shakes off a hard tumble down a flight of steps.

reply.summary: Tuveo grows old beside a bitter, brooding master and refuses to be his slave, patching wounds and talking back. When the order comes he blows up the family's secret cavern and empties its accounts.

feats.scene: Tuveo sets off the self-destruct that brings down the cavern and the manor above it.
Tuveo carries on working through a night of tremors and falling stone.

reply.summary: Llitire is the spotless valet in a world with a flying champion in place of a masked one. To shield a friend's secret, he dresses up as his employer and plays the part with total conviction.

feats.scene: Llitire pushes a stubborn intruder out of the drawing room with both hands.
Llitire keeps a straight face while a reporter peppers him with questions.

reply.summary: Celamo is a grey-haired domestic who tends the wounds of a family of night patrollers, steady hands and a calm word. He dresses cuts, resets shoulders and says very little about it.

feats.scene: Celamo sets a dislocated shoulder back into place in one firm motion.
Celamo stays up for three nights straight patching the injured.

reply.summary: Rnimonle is a gaslit-era attendant who keeps nagging his master to find a wife and quit his crusade. When the master lands in a cell, he smuggles a sleek motorbike across the city in a crate.

feats.scene: Rnimonle hoists a crate onto a cart and rolls it into a dark alley.
Rnimonle stands firm against a snarling crowd at a fairground.

reply.summary: Seoneton is the faithful steward of a grand estate in a darkened world, loyal to the last, with a father who served the same house. He turns up as a collectible helper in a battle game.

feats.scene: Seoneton lifts a loaded tray and sweeps it across the floor without a spill.
Seoneton stays standing through a long, tense night.

reply.summary: Arseole watches a hero fall into ruin and, in grief, wakes a hidden cloning engine to give the boy a gentler second life. He builds a vast replica of the old streets beneath a burning desert for the clone to grow up in.

feats.scene: Arseole throws the lever that wakes the cloning engine in a dark vault.
Arseole survives a ferocious mob outside a crumbling hall.

reply.summary: Orios is a bouncy plastic-brick manservant, happy to dance, take photographs and toss gadgets at the heroes while they study clues. His acrobatics are goofy and his loyalty is complete.

feats.scene: Orios flings a plastic tray across a cave and knocks a villain flat.
Orios bounces off a wall of loose bricks and snaps back together.

reply.summary: Eotesar is an old servant who is dying and bathes in a pool of green fluid mixed with a monster serum. His strength returns long enough to cook one last holiday dinner, then fades by the week's end.

feats.scene: Eotesar carves a roast with surprising vigour after his bath.
Eotesar rises from a deathbed made new by the strange waters.

reply.summary: Raami is a rubbery face stuck among a pile of novelty masks, chatting happily until someone yanks him off. He is a visual gag more than a person, and a very cheerful one.

feats.scene: Raami flaps his rubber lips and nudges a teen's hand away.
Raami is torn from a gag costume and stretches without tearing.

reply.summary: Riaiaiu is a small brick butler with a dry wit who keeps a cheerful household running while its heroic owner sulks. He is more composed than the minifigure scale would suggest.

feats.scene: Riaiaiu shoves a heap of bricks aside and clears a path.
Riaiaiu survives a tumble down a stack of toy furniture.

reply.summary: Iumlan quietly sets a tea service for a patrol in a world where one small event went differently. He observes the heroes with a patient eye and pours without being asked.

feats.scene: Iumlan hauls a trunk up a winding staircase in one go.
Iumlan works through a sleepless week of emergencies.

reply.summary: Tirnti is a black-haired manservant who occasionally pulls on a feathered mask and tags along as a sidekick. Under that cheerful costume he is every bit as devoted and a little more daring.

feats.scene: Tirnti swoops in wearing the feathered cowl and tackles a lurking gunman.
Tirnti takes a hard knock in a rooftop scuffle and gets up grinning.

reply.summary: Miseo is a grey, horned brute who started as a human security chief and a hidden lover, then swallowed a drug that twisted him into a monster. Fists like boulders and a hide like iron make him a menace.

feats.scene: Miseo punches through a tower wall and sends a whole corner crashing down.
Miseo takes a falling girder on his horned skull and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Iumrn is a bedridden old servant on a breathing machine, kept alive by borrowed cold technology. With his last strength he tends a wounded master and writes a farewell note.

feats.scene: Iumrn pulls himself upright and dresses a deep gash with trembling hands.
Iumrn lingers through a long illness before the final night.

reply.summary: Lallaco was a soldier of an ancient desert city who found a glowing relic and became something no longer human. He swore to hunt others of his kind and plays a bitter game of rivalry across the centuries.

feats.scene: Lallaco hurls a column of stone across the courtyard with a single transformed arm.
Lallaco's altered flesh turns aside a volley of spears.

reply.summary: Veorarni is a turbaned swindler who stages fake killings in a hotel so frightened guests pay for protection. Spun in his own headwear by a speedster, he is bundled up and caught.

feats.scene: Veorarni orders his goons to seize a clerk and drag him into a back room.
Veorarni is wrapped in yards of cloth by a whirling blur and cannot break free.

reply.summary: Neium is a cloned soldier from a bleak future where the sun was turned red, and she wears her stolen strength like armour. Thrown back in time, she fights a young farm hero with a poisoned weapon and is defeated by her own blade.

feats.scene: Neium punches a heavy truck clean across a field.
Neium shrugs off a tanker explosion without a scratch.
Neium streaks across a farmland in the blink of an eye.

reply.summary: Tautilva is a quiet student who learns that her bloodline carries an old curse: wherever she goes, tempers flare and fear spreads. She resolves to stop apologising and take control of it.

feats.scene: Tautilva's presence drives a crowded hall into a sudden brawl.
Tautilva is thrown against a locker and keeps her stubborn stare.

reply.summary: Cinrause is a mirror-wielding trickster from a madcap brotherhood of absurd villains. Anyone who looks into her glass grows old in moments, and she giggles at the wrinkles.

feats.scene: Cinrause holds up her mirror and ages a whole squad into frail elders.
Cinrause laughs off a punch to the ribs from a masked fighter.

reply.summary: Tenitir is a gentle grandmother in a crowded borough with an old sorrow for a lost love. She watches over her family and a legend made of clay that her granddaughter will one day lead.

feats.scene: Tenitir swats a stray cat off the porch with a rolled newspaper.
Tenitir endures a bitter winter on a draughty tenement stair.

reply.summary: Setel is a quiet student in dark clothes who loves biology and is quick to stand up for a friend. When a brash bully pushes too far, she and a plant-obsessed classmate grow closer than either planned.

feats.scene: Setel shoves a bully away from a locker in a crowded hallway.
Setel takes a hard shove into a wall and stays defiant.
